audit.why: 47.55% over 1186 games — slightly Brand-favored overall despite Mel winning most lane stages; his teamfight R and Blaze burst carry harder later. EVEN 5.5/10 is defensible.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: His window: Pyroclasm bounces plus Blaze detonations can burst you through a single Sear stun.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q is 8s at rank 1 and only stuns when you are ablaze; after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. - His W Pillar runs a 10s cooldown — step up inside that gap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: E Solar Snare his step-up — rooted at the orb's center he eats the whole Q barrage, and an immobile mage has no answer to it.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: E Solar Snare thrown just to make space leaves his next stun window unanswered — the root is your kill setup on a mage with no escape.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze, stunning you with Sear once ablaze, and detonating the passive with Pyroclasm bounces.

notes: Packet flags the chart as contradicting the 47.55% WR, but the chart is coherent with both layers' prose (Brand's only stage is level 6) — the WR gap is teamfight-driven, so I kept the chart shape and only aligned the full-layer sides. Content spikes[2].text and wants.you[1] claim Rebuttal reflects Brand's W Pillar of Flame; the kit text describes a delayed ground area (likely a mis-derived projectile flag), and I could not verify reflect eligibility from the kits, so I left those strings untouched rather than guess.
